mapper.select: SELECT c.care_number AS careNumber, c.care_title AS careTitle, c.care_write_date AS careDate, CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ddd_care_apply a WHERE a.care_number = c.care_number), '/', c.care_recruit) AS applyStatus, c.care_recruit AS careRecruit FROM ddd_care c WHERE c.user_number = #{userNumber} AND c.care_status != 'deleted' ORDER BY c.care_number DESC
